proof_roadmap: Sense-making of the statement comes from the continuity of rig-etale-ness (lemma-rig-etale-continuous).
Given rig-etale B to A and adic B to C, choose an ideal of definition I of B giving the I-adic topology on both A and C.
Apply the base-change lemma for rig-etale homomorphisms to conclude the completed tensor product A times_C is rig-etale over (C, IC).
